channel.title: FilesBolt updates
channel.description: New features and fixes in each FilesBolt update.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.30
item.description: Fixes Settings not opening for some people.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.29
item.description: Safer file conversions and a new Download my data option in Settings.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.25
item.description: FilesBolt now speaks Spanish, French, German and Hindi: Settings > General > Language. Other small fixes.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.23
item.description: FilesBolt now speaks Spanish: Settings > General > Language. Other small fixes.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.21
item.description: PDF to Word now works even without Microsoft Word. Edit & sign: Select can now pick up part of the page itself, to move, resize or erase it. Compress makes many PDFs much smaller. Updates download more reliably.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.20
item.description: Merging now always saves, even with an unusual file name. PDF to Word tells you right away if your Microsoft Word is too old. Other small fixes.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.18
item.description: Show password: click the eye in any password box. Signing in with a deleted account now tells you so. Extra protection when deleting an account with two-step sign-in on.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.16
item.description: Edit & sign: remove any single item with its red x, right-click to Delete / Duplicate / Bring to front / Rotate, bigger handles, More colours, neater B/I/U, eyedropper fixes.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.15
item.description: Cleaner tooltips with shortcut keys. Invite codes fill in automatically when you sign up from a friend's link. Edit & sign thumbnails turn with the page. More reliable updates.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.13
item.description: FilesBolt is free during our launch. Animated sidebar icons. Edit & sign: brush, double arrow, notes, Paint-style Select, rotate pages, fixes. Choose which emails you get. Take a screenshot in Contact support.

item.title: FilesBolt 0.4.11
item.description: Edit & sign opens big PDFs in about a second and shows text sharp at any zoom. Fix: if an older copy of FilesBolt was on the PC, shortcuts now always open the newest version.
